name: Lençóis Maranhenses National Park
description: On Brazil's northeastern Maranhão coast, Lençóis Maranhenses is a vast field of pale sand dunes, the largest in South America, rolling inland from the Atlantic. Each rainy season, water fills the valleys between the dunes and forms thousands of blue and green lagoons. The scenery is at its best when the lagoons are fullest, with sand and water stretching to the horizon.
